lines: The sun rises over distant hill
And paints the clouds in gold
With light that shines and bends my will
A sight I never tire to hold
The streets are filled with cars and crowds
Where people rush both night and day
Moving beneath the heavy clouds
Each searching for a brighter way
I chop the onions into small
And heat the oil until it sings
Then watch the vapors rise and fall
The smell of garlic that it brings
The engine turns with metal sound
And gears that mesh in perfect time
It spins and spins and goes around
A dance that's ancient yet sublime
The rain descends in sheets so thick
And drums upon the roof above
Each drop a small and silver stick
That falls with all the force of love
A piano starts with one low note
And melodies come floating through
The music makes my heart to float
A feeling fresh and warm and new
The eagle spreads its wings so wide
And catches wind beneath its form
It soars with such majestic pride
Above the clouds and coming storm
The flowers bloom in colors bright
And bees dance from each flower head
Their petals catch the morning light
With white and gold and perfect red
The waves crash hard upon the shore
And leave behind their sandy trace
Then pull back out to find some more
In rhythm, time, and endless space
When darkness falls across the land
The stars come out so bright and clear
Like diamonds scattered by a hand
They guide us through the sleeping year
I open up a brand new book
And wander through the written page
With every tale, another look
Discovering each hidden stage
When flowers wake in spring's first bloom
And sunlight wakes the earth below
Where gardens burst from winter's gloom
And all the gentle creatures grow
The petals spread so bright and wide
With colors that will bring you cheer
Where vines and flowers gently glide
Through seasons of the changing year
The harbor holds the ships at rest
And sailors watch for every sail
Where morning gulls call from their nest
When winds blow strong with sea and gale
The mountains rise so high and steep
With peaks of white and frozen stone
Where silence stretches cold and deep
And echoes make their ancient moan
The train speeds on its iron path
With smoke that billows through the night
The engine shudders forth in wrath
As stations fade from fading sight
The bakery holds a golden scent
With bread so warm and fresh and sweet
Where flour dust is gently spent
And dough is kneaded good and neat
The library holds a thousand books
With stories waiting to be found
In quiet rooms and quiet nooks
Where whispers make a gentle sound
The storm brings rain and wind and might
With lightning streaking through the dark
The clouds descend to steal the light
And thunder leaves its blazing mark
The autumn leaves turn red and gold
As trees prepare to rest and sleep
While winds blow harsh against the cold
And frost descends from skies so deep
The summer sun beats hot and bright
With heat that shimmers on the ground
And daylight lasts till late at night
While crickets make a singing sound
The winter frost will freeze the lake
As snow comes drifting down so soft
And ice will form for children's sake
While clouds drift slowly high aloft
The harbor bells ring out so clear
As boats return from distant shore
While merchants gather all in cheer
And unload treasures by the store
The river starts where mountains throw
Their water down the ancient steep
It moves along both fast and slow
Where shadows dark and lasting creep
The hammer makes its rhythmic sound
Within the workshop's golden light
As tools rest on the dusty ground
Where craftsmen work from morn to night
The merchants gather in the shade
Where bargains echo strong and loud
Their wares are bought and goods are paid
For every soul within the crowd
The desert spreads its golden sand
Beneath the vast and endless sky
No water flows through arid land
Where winds and wild mirages fly
The lanterns hang in perfect line
And cast their warm and gentle glow
Their golden rays so bright and fine
Make shadows dance and softly flow
The apple hangs from every tree
While blossoms fill the orchard room
The branches stretch so wild and free
And fragrant petals break the gloom
The snowfields stretch so clean and white
Where nothing breaks the crystal cold
They sparkle with a blinding light
Like mountains made of ancient gold
The bridge will help us safely cross
The river on its winding way
Through all the rain and winter's loss
We pass upon it every day
The river like a silver stream
Flows over every ancient stone
It sparkles like a distant dream
Where willows weep and birds have flown
The craftsmen at the workshop work
Where sunlight floods the space so bright
In corners does the hammer lurk
And all the pieces fit just right
The merchants gather round to trade
Their wares throughout the crowded way
The finest goods are on parade
And customers return each day
Beneath the desert's scorching heat
The travelers journey through the vast
Their weary hearts and aching feet
Remember memories of the past
